title: Advanced React Patterns
description: Build advanced React patterns from scratch — compound components, render props, custom hooks composition, and higher-order components.

steps.title: Compound component: Tabs
steps.description: Create a compound component pattern for a `Tabs` component. Export `Tabs`, `Tabs.Tab`, and `Tabs.Panel` — where `Tabs.Tab` toggles visibility of the matching `Tabs.Panel` by index. Use `React.Children.map` and `React.cloneElement` to pass shared state. Log the active tab index when it changes.
hints: Tabs maintains activeIndex state via useState
Use React.Children.map to pass activeIndex and onSelect to Tabs.Tab children
Tabs.Panel shows its children only when its index matches activeIndex

verification.successMessage: Compound Tabs component renders tabs and panels!
verification.failureMessage: Make sure Tabs renders both Tab buttons and Panel content areas.

steps.title: Render props: DataFetcher
steps.description: Create a `DataFetcher` component that uses the render props pattern. It takes a `url` prop and calls a function as its child with `{ data, loading, error }`. Use setTimeout to simulate an async fetch. Render loading, error, and data states.
hints: The component's child is a function: ({ data, loading, error }) => JSX
Use useState for { data, loading, error } states
Simulate fetch with setTimeout that resolves after 1 second

verification.failureMessage: DataFetcher should render its children as a function with data/loading/error state.

steps.title: Custom hook: useLocalStorage
steps.description: Create a `useLocalStorage(key, initialValue)` custom hook that syncs state with localStorage. Read from localStorage on mount, update localStorage on change, and provide a setter. Print the stored value to verify.
hints: Use useState with a lazy initializer that reads from localStorage
Wrap the setter to also write to localStorage
Handle JSON parse errors gracefully with a try/catch

verification.successMessage: useLocalStorage hook reads from and writes to localStorage!
verification.failureMessage: Render a component that uses useLocalStorage and displays the stored value.

steps.title: Compose hooks: useUserPreferences
steps.description: Create a `useUserPreferences` hook that composes `useLocalStorage` to manage theme ('light'|'dark'), fontSize (number), and language preferences. Return an object with all preferences and individual setters. Log the preferences to the console.
hints: Call useLocalStorage three times with different keys
Return { theme, setTheme, fontSize, setFontSize, language, setLanguage }
Print the preferences object with console.log

verification.successMessage: Composed hooks provide a clean preferences API!
verification.failureMessage: useUserPreferences should return theme, fontSize, and language with their setters.

steps.title: Error boundary with HOC pattern
steps.description: Create an `withErrorBoundary(WrappedComponent, fallbackUI)` higher-order component that wraps a component with error catching. If the wrapped component throws, render the fallback UI instead. Test by creating a component that intentionally throws.
hints: Use React's componentDidCatch or static getDerivedStateFromError
The HOC returns a new class component with error state
fallbackUI is a render function called with the error object

verification.successMessage: Error boundary HOC catches and displays errors gracefully!
verification.failureMessage: The error boundary should catch the thrown error and render the fallback UI.
